# Speech-to-text meeting notes

*Client industry: consulting | Completed: 2022-04-16 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p12*

## The problem
The client was a consultancy losing action items after calls.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, a Redis-backed background task queue. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project produced searchable notes within 5 minutes of each call.
